design_gotchas.title: CRITICAL ESD Trap: Standard onsemi LM358DR2G Is Rated ONLY 250 V HBM / 100 V MM (p.3)!
design_gotchas.detail: Page 3 ESD Ratings explicitly single out LM358DG/DR2G and LM2904DG/DR2G at ONLY 250 V HBM / 100 V MM—8x lower than the 2000 V HBM on LM358EDR2G, NCV2904, and all other variants in the same datasheet (and 2x lower than TI LM358DR's 500 V HBM). Exposed connector or field-serviceable inputs MUST use LM358EDR2G (2000 V HBM) or external ESD clamping.

design_gotchas.title: Higher 212 °C/W Minimum-Pad RθJA, 45 nA Input Bias & Lower 70 dB CMRR vs TI LM358DR
design_gotchas.detail: Although pin-for-pin second-source compatible with TI LM358DR, onsemi LM358DR2G specifies 212 °C/W min-pad RθJA (vs TI 124.7 °C/W JEDEC), 2.25x higher typical input bias current (45 nA vs 20 nA), lower typical CMRR (70 dB vs 80 dB), and tighter upper CM limit at 25°C (VCC - 1.7 V vs VCC - 1.5 V; both VCC - 2.0 V over temp).

design_gotchas.title: Identical SOIC-8 Pinout Trap vs Open-Collector LM393DR2G Comparator & Commercial 0–70°C Cap
design_gotchas.detail: LM358DR2G shares the exact SOIC-8 pinout of onsemi LM393DR2G comparator (1=OUT_A, 2=IN-_A, 3=IN+_A, 4=VEE/GND, 5=IN+_B, 6=IN-_B, 7=OUT_B, 8=VCC) yet is a compensated push-pull op-amp—never cross-swap with comparators. Also note 0°C to +70°C commercial temp rating (use LM2904DR2G for -40..105°C or LM2904VDR2G for -40..125°C).

design_gotchas.title: Non-RRIO Upper Headroom (VCC - 1.7 V / -2.0 V), Class-B Crossover & Output-to-VCC Short Hazard
design_gotchas.detail: Output high swings only to ~3.5 V typ (3.3 V min) on a 5 V rail into 2 kOhm, low-side sink collapses to 12 uA min / 50 uA typ at VO = 200 mV (Class-B crossover distortion), and Footnote 6 (p.4) warns that output shorts to VCC (or simultaneous shorts on both channels) can thermally destroy the package.

typical_use_cases: Drop-in multi-source second source for TI LM358DR in commercial (0°C–70°C) 5 V–30 V industrial/consumer boards
Low-side current sensing and ground-referenced DC control loops leveraging 0 V negative common-mode inclusion
Cost-optimized power-supply regulation loops, battery chargers, and slow (<10 kHz) active filters
Legacy single-supply or split-supply (±15 V) analog signal conditioning where 250 V HBM ESD handling is controlled
engineering_summary: The onsemi LM358DR2G is a commercial-grade (0°C to +70°C) dual general-purpose bipolar operational amplifier in SOIC-8 (CASE 751) operating from 3.0 V to 30 V/32 V (±16 V split) with ground-sensing PNP inputs, ~1.0 MHz GBWP, ~0.6 V/us slew rate, 350 uA/ch typ Iq, and ±40 mA short-circuit output drive. While pin-identical to TI LM358DR, engineers auditing a BOM second source MUST catch its critical 250 V HBM ESD rating on standard LM358DR2G (vs 2000 V HBM on LM358EDR2G), higher 212 °C/W minimum-pad RθJA, 45 nA typ input bias current, 70 dB typ CMRR, and non-interchangeability with pin-identical LM393DR2G comparators.

audit_notes: 300 DPI PNG Vision on p.1 confirmed Rev. 36 (September 2024), SOIC-8 CASE 751 Top View pinout (1=Output A, 2=IN- A, 3=IN+ A, 4=VEE/Gnd, 5=IN+ B, 6=IN- B, 7=Output B, 8=VCC).

300 DPI PNG Vision on p.3 confirmed Maximum Ratings (VCC = 32 V / ±16 V, TJ = 150°C, CASE 751 RθJA = 212 °C/W, RθJC = 72 °C/W, TA = 0..70°C for LM358) and caught the critical ESD table trap: LM358DG/DR2G = 250 V HBM / 100 V MM vs 2000 V HBM on LM358E/NCV2904.

300 DPI PNG Vision on p.4 confirmed LM358 Electrical Characteristics (VIO = 2 mV typ / 7 mV max @ 25°C, IIB = -45 nA typ / -250 nA max -> 45000 pA, CMR = 70 dB typ / 65 dB min, ISC = 40 mA typ / 60 mA max, total ICC = 0.7 mA typ at 5 V -> 350 uA/ch).

300 DPI PNG Vision on p.6 verified typical AC curves absent from p.4 table: Fig. 5 open-loop gain crosses 0 dB at 1.0 MHz (gbwp_mhz = 1.0) and Fig. 3 large-signal voltage follower swings ~3.0 V per ~5.0 us division (~0.6 V/us); Path A confirmed Active ordering OPN LM358DR2G on p.10.
